data.final_week_advice: Focus on timed practice and reviewing common errors in differentiation and integration applications.
data.summary: This plan covers all AP Calculus AB units over 10 weeks, starting with foundational limits and differentiation. It integrates live classes in the first two weeks and dedicates the final two weeks to mixed review and timed practice to prepare for the exam.

weeks.focus: Master limits and introductory differentiation concepts.
tasks: Attend live classes for Units 1-4 and take detailed notes.
Complete 10 practice problems on estimating limits from graphs and tables.
Solve 5 problems on average and instantaneous rates of change.
Review the chain rule and implicit differentiation with 5 example problems.

weeks.focus: Deepen understanding of differentiation applications and MVT.
tasks: Attend live class on the Mean Value Theorem.
Solve 5 related rates problems involving motion and non-motion contexts.
Practice identifying critical points and using the First Derivative Test on 5 functions.
Review the connection between differentiability and continuity with 3 proof-based questions.

weeks.focus: Introduce integration and accumulation of change.
tasks: Complete 5 Riemann sum approximation problems using left, right, and midpoint rectangles.
Practice converting summation notation to definite integral notation for 3 functions.
Solve 5 problems using the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus to evaluate definite integrals.
Review the concept of accumulation functions with 3 applied scenarios.

weeks.focus: Master differential equations and slope fields.
tasks: Model 3 real-world situations using differential equations.
Verify solutions for 5 differential equations by substitution.
Sketch slope fields for 3 differential equations and identify solution curves.
Reason about the behavior of solutions using slope fields for 2 problems.

weeks.focus: Apply integration to find areas and average values.
tasks: Calculate the average value of 3 functions on given intervals.
Solve 5 problems connecting position, velocity, and acceleration using integrals.
Find the area between 3 pairs of curves expressed as functions of x.
Review accumulation functions in applied contexts with 2 word problems.
Complete 10 mixed practice problems on limits, continuity, and derivatives.
Solve 5 problems involving the chain rule and implicit differentiation.
Practice evaluating definite integrals using the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus for 5 functions.
Review the Mean Value Theorem and Extreme Value Theorem with 3 application problems.

weeks.focus: Review contextual applications and differential equations.
tasks: Solve 5 related rates problems in various contexts.
Practice interpreting the meaning of the derivative in context for 3 scenarios.
Model and verify solutions for 3 differential equations.
Sketch and analyze slope fields for 3 differential equations.
Calculate the area between 3 pairs of curves.
Solve 5 problems involving average value and accumulation functions.
Practice connecting position, velocity, and acceleration using integrals for 3 scenarios.
Review Riemann sums and definite integral notation with 5 problems.

weeks.focus: Timed practice and mixed review of all units.
tasks: Complete a 45-minute timed practice set of 10 multiple-choice questions covering all units.
Solve 5 free-response questions on differentiation and integration applications.
Review common errors in limits, derivatives, and integrals.
Practice interpreting graphs and tables for limits and derivatives.

weeks.focus: Final exam preparation and timed practice.
tasks: Complete a full 90-minute timed practice exam.
Review and correct all mistakes from the practice exam.
Focus on weak areas identified in the practice exam.
Practice free-response questions on related rates, differential equations, and area between curves.
